'''Autumn's Bounty''' is a [[Cooking|cooked dish]]. It is prepared using either the kitchen inside an upgraded [[farmhouse]] or a [[Cookout Kit]]. Five Autumn's Bounties are the reward for completing the {{Bundle|Exotic||y}}.

Autumn's Bounty may randomly appear in [[Krobus]]' shop on [[Days of the Week#Saturday|Saturdays]], in the [[Garbage Can]] outside the saloon, or in [[The Stardrop Saloon]]'s rotating stock.  Five Autumn's Bounties may occasionally be found in a [[Skull Cavern#Treasure Rooms|treasure room]] in the Skull Cavern. One Autumn's Bounty may be received from opening a [[Mystery Box]].

==Tailoring==
Autumn's Bounty is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[Tailoring|Belted Coat]].  [[File:Shirt221.png|24px]] It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as an orange dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].
